description: Take a screenshot of the current page (localhost pages included): the viewport as JPEG, downscaled to 1024 px wide, by default. For visual QA pass width/height (breakpoints 375 / 768 / 1440 — emulated for this capture only), fullPage for the whole page, and save or path to write a PNG and get its path. Prefer browser_snapshot to read structure; it is far more token-efficient.

format.description: Image format. Default: JPEG for the returned image, PNG for a saved file.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of the viewport.

height.description: Viewport height in CSS px for this capture only (default: the current height).

maxWidth.description: Downscale the returned image to this width in px (default 1024). 0 = native resolution. A saved file is always full resolution.

path.description: Absolute .png / .jpg / .jpeg file to save to, inside a registered project or the screenshots folder (implies save). Parent folders are created; only an existing image is ever replaced.

quality.description: JPEG quality 10-100 (default 60 for the returned image, 90 for a saved JPEG).

save.description: Also save the full-resolution image as a file (default folder ~/.synabun/data/media/screenshots/<date>/) and return its path.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

width.description: Viewport width in CSS px for this capture only, e.g. 375, 768 and 1440 for breakpoints. Emulated on the tab (mobile below 768) and reset right after.

name: browser_screenshot
